prompt:
Using the transurethral resection of the prostate (TURP) report, please extract several pieces of information: 1) whether prostatic adenocarcinoma was present (0 for no, 1 for yes), 2) the percentage of prostate tissue / chips involved (e.g. <5%, 50%, 5-10%), and 3) the highest Gleason score noted (in primary + secondary score format, e.g. 4+5). These should be reported, in order, in this compact JSON format: {{"pca": "[0 or 1]", "pct": "[percentage involved]", "gs": "[Gleason score, e.g. 4+5]"}}. Use the following rules in your analysis:
- For prostate adenocarcinoma diagnosis (first field), only report 1 if the histology is specifically adenocarcinoma; if small cell or other variant histology, report 0. Report "N/A" if the report does not include a TURP; sometimes the reports are from bladder biopsies (TURBT), radical prostatectomies, or formal prostate biopsies. Sometimes, TURP is combined with a prostate biopsy, bladder resection, or other procedure; for these, report the findings from the TURP. If there is no TURP / transurethral prostate resection noted, report "N/A".
- For the second field (percent of tissue/chips involved), report the percentage as written in the report (e.g. 50%). If a range is given, report the range (e.g. 11-20%). If only a qualitative descriptor is given, report the descriptor (e.g. 'all' or 'majority'). If only the raw number of chips and total number of chips are given, report the fraction involved (e.g. 4/125 chips). If not given in the report, use "N/A".
- For the third field (highest Gleason score), report in (primary+secondary) format, like "3+4", "3+3", etc. If no adenocarcinoma is present, or if no Gleason score is given, report "N/A".
{input}
